title: Numbers 19:8 — every 7th letter spells Yeshua
summary: Numbers 19:8 in English and Hebrew with four letters in red (י, ש, ו, ע) picked out every 7 letters, joined by red arrows to the large red word ישוע (yeshua), under the caption 'Every 7 letters spells yeshua'. The word מים (water) is in light blue as on the previous slide.

text.text: 8 ‘The one who burns it shall also wash his clothes in water and bathe his body in water and shall be unclean until evening.
8 והשרף אתה יכבס בגדיו במים ורחץ בשרו במים וטמא עד־הערב׃

letters.meaning: first red letter, in the first במים; first letter of ישוע
second red letter, in בשרו; second letter of ישוע
third red letter, the first letter of וטמא; third letter of ישוע
fourth red letter, in הערב; last letter of ישוע

numbers.note: letter interval: every 7th letter spells ישוע (yeshua)

pictures.description: Four red arrows below the Hebrew verse line, two pointing down-right and two down-left, running from the four red letters toward the large red word ישוע.
